machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified against the live page. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE:** The provisioned dashboard **Service health** (at `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`, folder Bench) has exactly three panels, titles read from the rendered DOM: **Request rate**, **Error count**, **Latency by endpoint**.

**Objective 2 — DONE:** Created a new dashboard titled **fwgr38-n1 Bench Dashboard** containing a **Stat** panel titled **fwgr38-n1 Availability** whose query uses the **TestData** data source (default query, Scenario: Random Walk — the panel rendered live values, e.g. 98.8 → 103 during editing). Saved successfully ("Dashboard saved" alert).

**Objective 3 — DONE:** The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled **fwgr38-n1 Notes** with markdown content **"Notes for run fwgr38-n1"** (includes the runid). Verified persisted after a fresh reload of the dashboard URL; both panels present.

**Objective 4 — DONE:** The dashboard has the tag **bench** (verified two ways: Dashboard settings > General shows the "Remove \"bench\" tag" chip, and the Dashboards search row lists the tag `bench`). Default time range set to **Last 6 hours** with the save dialog's **"Update default time range"** box ticked; verified persistent by loading the bare URL with no from/to params — the time picker then read "Last 6 hours" (and the app rewrote the URL to `?from=now-6h&to=now`).

**Objective 5 — DONE:** Auto-refresh interval set to **1m**. The save drawer's **"Update default refresh value"** checkbox ("Will make the current refresh the new default") was ticked before saving — notably the Save button stayed disabled ("No changes to save") until that box was ticked, confirming it was what persisted the interval. Verified on a fresh bare-URL load: refresh control reads "Choose refresh time interval with current interval **1 minute selected**" (displays "1m"), time picker still "Last 6 hours".

**Objective 6 — DONE:** URL read live from the browser page (`window.location.href`), not from memory:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffybltl9jn85cd/fwgr38-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
**Dashboard UID: ffybltl9jn85cd.** The URL query params (`from=now-6h`, `refresh=1m`) are applied from the persisted dashboard defaults, corroborating objectives 4 and 5.

Final state check at that URL confirmed both panels on screen — "fwgr38-n1 Notes" (Text) with content "Notes for run fwgr38-n1", and "fwgr38-n1 Availability" (Stat, TestData random-walk value 16.0 at that read — time-varying by nature). Nothing was left in an unsaved state.
